_comment: Canonical source of truth for reserved hotkey shortcuts. The backend (voice_typer/server/config_validators.py via json.load) reads this file directly. This file is intentionally duplicated (byte-identical copy) at voice_typer/client/src/renderer/src/data/hotkey_reserved.json because importing via the @server alias resolved outside the renderer root and crashed Vite's dev server during HMR on locale switch (see the RTL-crash fix). Drift between the two copies is caught by tests/test_hotkey_reserved_sync.py and the pre-commit hook (id: hotkey-reserved-sync) in .pre-commit-config.yaml, which runs the sync test before any commit that touches either file. HOTKEY-SHARED-001 (Task 1.4): the previous architecture duplicated this table in two places (hardcoded RESERVED_SHORTCUTS in hotkey-validation.ts and _RESERVED_HOTKEYS in config_validators.py) with no automated sync mechanism — a mismatch silently accepted/rejected conflicting hotkeys.

_format.universal_reserved: Array of hotkey strings blocked on EVERY platform (window management: Alt+Tab, Alt+F4, Alt+Esc, Alt+Space). Stored lowercase with angle brackets, e.g. "<alt>+<tab>".
_format.per_platform_reserved: Object mapping platform key (win32/darwin/linux) to array of hotkey strings blocked on that platform only.
_format.blocked_ctrl_letters: Array of single lowercase letters blocked when the hotkey is PURE Ctrl+<letter> (no other modifier). Covers Copy/Paste/Undo/Save/Select All/etc.
_format.modifiers: Array of modifier key names recognized in hotkey strings (pynput-style, lowercase).
